description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudio SetCaps task, which configures GStreamer caps for a WebAudio player component. It uses Google Test framework to verify correct behavior of setting caps with various audio formats and configurations.

classes.name: WebAudioSetCapsTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing the SetCaps task in WebAudio player, setting up mock objects and common test data.

methods.name: getPcmFormat
methods.description: Constructs a string representing the PCM format based on configuration flags.

methods.name: expectBuildPcmCaps
methods.description: Sets expectations for building GStreamer caps with the current PCM configuration.

methods.name: expectGetCapsStr
methods.description: Sets expectations for converting caps to string and freeing the string.

methods.name: expectSetCaps
methods.description: Sets expectations for getting current appsrc caps and setting new caps if they differ.

methods.name: expectUnref
methods.description: Sets expectations for unreferencing caps objects.

methods.name: expectSetBytesPerSamplePcm
methods.description: Verifies that the expected bytes per sample are correctly calculated.
